concerns.text: FR-001 (download 200 PRs) and FR-002 (classify PRs) lack a completed task to generate the primary artifact `data/processed/prs_labeled.csv`. Task T017 is marked `[ ]` (incomplete) and T019b (manual audit runner) is also `[ ]`. Without T017, downstream tasks T022, T033a, and T024a have no input data, blocking the entire pipeline for FR-003, FR-004, FR-005, and SC-001/002.

FR-003 (metrics), FR-004 (t-tests), FR-005 (complexity), FR-008 (sensitivity), and SC-001/002/003 rely on `prs_labeled.csv` and `complexity_scores.csv`. Tasks T022, T023, T024a, T024b, T025, T026, T027, T028, T033a, T033b, and T035 are all marked `[ ]` (incomplete). The spec requires these analyses to be performed, but no executable tasks exist to produce the required outputs.

concerns.text: FR-006 (visualizations) and the final report generation (T036d, T037) depend on the statistical results from Phase 4. Tasks T030a, T030b, T031, T034, T036b, T036d, and T037 are marked `[ ]` (incomplete). The spec requires boxplots and a final report, but the tasks to generate them are not defined as complete.

FR-001 (strict fail-on-error), FR-002 (confidence calibration), and FR-007 (deterministic seed) require specific robustness implementations. Tasks T044, T048, and T050 are marked `[ ]` (incomplete). While these are 'Review Resolution' tasks, the core functionality they refine (e.g., error handling in T044) is critical for the 'Fail Loudly' requirement in FR-001 and is currently missing from the implementation plan.

Tasks T007, T009, and T018 are marked `[X]` but contain the comment `<!-- FAILED: unspecified -->`. This indicates the task description is incomplete or the implementation is not fully specified, which contradicts the `[X]` (complete) status. These should be either marked `[ ]` with a clear description of the missing logic or updated to be fully specified.

Task T021a is marked `[X]` but contains `<!-- FAILED: unspecified -->`. Similar to T007/T009, this indicates an incomplete definition for the Mann-Whitney U test implementation, despite being marked as complete.
